needs.understand: I want to understand my feelings

stressed.title: Try a one-minute breathing reset
stressed.body: A single quiet minute can soften the edges of a stressful day.

anxious.title: Talk to your companion, or ground yourself
anxious.body: The 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise is a gentle place to start.

sad.title: A supportive conversation or a soft activity
sad.body: You do not have to explain everything — a few words are enough.

overwhelmed.title: Break the day into smaller pieces
overwhelmed.body: A short pause first, then one small step at a time.

calm.title: Keep the good moment going
calm.body: Explore an activity, or simply carry on with your day.

happy.title: Record your positive moment
happy.body: Tiny wins add up — save this one in your mood journey.

okay.title: Choose whatever feels right
okay.body: A puzzle, a breathing break, or a chat — there is no wrong choice.
